run_update_tiny_models: run the update_tiny_models CLI to create and upload tiny-random models for all architectures to the HuggingFace Hub
create_tiny_models_cli: create tiny random models for all or selected model types via argparse CLI with optional Hub upload
get_all_model_names: get all model class names from the transformers auto modeling mappings
get_tiny_model_names_from_repo: get existing tiny model names from the local tiny_model_summary.json file
get_tiny_model_summary_from_hub: query the HuggingFace Hub for existing tiny-random models and build a summary with tokenizer, processor, and model classes
